arguments.where_clause: transactions.amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND transactions.card_id IN (SELECT cards.id FROM cards WHERE cards.card_type = 'Debit')
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $1,000 made on a Debit card (card_type 'Debit'). Prepaid debit cards are not included.
assumptions: 'Debit card' means card_type = 'Debit' exactly; 'Debit (Prepaid)' cards are excluded.
'Over $1,000' means amount_usd_cents > 100000, so the threshold is strictly greater than $1,000.
Negative amounts are not flagged because they fail the amount condition.
